summary.name: Cortexa
summary.one_liner: Cortexa is an AI medical scribe that generates reviewable clinical notes, according to a directory listing; the cortexanote.com page itself was blocked by a security service, so its details could not be verified.
use_cases: generating clinical notes from patient visits
summary.what_it_does: The cortexanote.com page could not be read: it shows a Cloudflare security block message instead of product content. The only product details come from the directory listing, which describes Cortexa as an AI medical scribe that generates clinical notes that a clinician can review. The listing also says there is a free tier with unlimited transcription and an optional clip-on recorder. These claims are not confirmed by the page text itself.
notable: Generates clinical notes that can be reviewed before use
Free tier listed with unlimited transcription
caveats: The product page was blocked by a security service, so features could not be verified
Paid tiers or limits beyond the free tier are not stated in the available text
